items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Because Queen Elizabeth and Ferdinand, they came in the theater.

ctx.x: Yes, it was a form of blackmail. But we had to do it. Because we couldn't go on. And then we moved on to Madrid. I know it was the Infanta Beatriz there. And we had played the show halfway through when we had to start it all over again. Because Queen Elizabeth and Ferdinand, they came in the theater. And, first place, we didn't know the Spanish National Anthem, so we had to run around and find somebody to play that for us, see?
